name: Ferienwohnung Kogler
beschreibung:
Quietly set in Erl, the Kogler family welcomes guests with genuine Tyrolean warmth in a well-kept apartment with a mountain-view balcony.

The festival venues, Mount Kranzhorn, and the Blaubergalm offer outstanding activities for culture and nature enthusiasts.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Kogler in Erl provides comfortable holiday lodgings in the festival village of Kufsteinerland.
